criterion: Maximize target-1 F1 on dev across the predeclared candidates. Threshold candidates are tested only on the baseline Logistic Regression scores; class weighting, C, and the second classifier are evaluated independently at their native default decision rules. If F1 ties within 1e-12, prefer the candidate with the fewest departures from the baseline, then the threshold closest to 0.50, then the lexicographically earliest name. Freeze the winner without consulting held-out.
